svg.aria-label: Recorded output: DSH's grant fails with access denied and the runner exits 127 before the repair; after the repair the same confined child writes successfully.
svg.text: dsh-windows-acl-preflight — recorded output, rendered to SVG (not a screen capture)

g.font-family: Cascadia Mono, Consolas, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
g.text: # 1. brand-new workspace, no repair: DSH's grant fails before the child process exists
$ node runner.js --workspace E:\ws --temp E:\ws-tmp --mode workspace-write -- pwsh ...
[exit 127] Win32 5 = ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED: the label lives in the SACL, so WRITE_OWNER is required
# 2. after the repair on the root (no elevation, DACL only)
same Win32 call (SecurityInfo 0x14) rc = 5 -> rc = 0, label = S:AI(ML;;NW;;;LW)
# 3. a subtree that was dropped in later: confined writes still fail, until the tree is propagated
err: Set-Content: Access to the path '...\pack\config\file.txt' is denied.
# 4. end to end, driven by this package's own modules
Source: README sections 2.1-2.3 of this repository. Placeholders in <angle brackets> stand for machine-specific values.
